proposals.old_text: - urgent: immediate action (system down, blocked workflow, security breach)
proposals.new_text: - urgent: immediate action (system down, blocked workflow, security breach) - only if critical to business continuity
proposals.hypothesis: Adding a clarifying clause helps prevent overgeneralization to 'urgent' by emphasizing that only critical issues should be labeled as such, not all technical or security issues.
proposals.expected_improvement: Reduction in overgeneralization to 'urgent' by 15-20% in failure cases, as the model will be more selective in applying this label.
